credentials.title: SMTP credentials
credentials.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
credentials.failed: Could not read the SMTP settings.

clear.title: Clear the mailbox?
clear.description_one: This permanently deletes the {count} captured message. It cannot be undone.
clear.description_other: This permanently deletes all {count} captured messages. It cannot be undone.

empty.title: No mail yet
empty.description: Point your app at the SMTP settings below and the messages it sends show up here.

list.label: Messages
list.noMatchDescription: Try another search or show all messages.

error.title: Mailpit did not answer
error.description: The mail service is not responding. Restarting it keeps the messages it already captured.

unavailable.title: Mail is not available
unavailable.description: This daemon does not offer the mail API yet.

offline.title: Waiting for the daemon
offline.description: The mailbox appears as soon as the connection is back.

noTool.title: Install Mailpit to catch your app's mail
noTool.description: Mailpit receives the messages your projects send while you develop and shows them here.

stopped.title: Mailpit is stopped
stopped.description: Start it to receive and read mail.

html.none: This message has no HTML part.
html.tooLarge: This message is too large to preview safely as HTML.

text.none: This message has no text part.

link.title: Open this link in your browser?
link.description: The link comes from the message and is untrusted. Check the address before opening it.
